/news/aces-fever-series-breakdown/.title: Aces vs. Fever series breakdown: Wilson won the matchup
/news/aces-fever-series-breakdown/.description: A'ja Wilson scored 96 points on 64.6% shooting as the Aces beat the Fever 2-1. Indiana won the paint in all three games. How the series was decided.

/news/aces-valkyries-semis-game-1-recap/.title: Valkyries own the glass, stun the Aces 71-60 in Game 1
/news/aces-valkyries-semis-game-1-recap/.description: Golden State grabbed 52 rebounds to Vegas's 25 and beat the Aces 71-60 in semifinal Game 1. The rebounding leader did not score. Full recap and stats.

/news/aces-valkyries-semis-game-2-recap/.title: Burton's three, Stokes' block lift Valkyries over Aces
/news/aces-valkyries-semis-game-2-recap/.description: Vegas led for 11 seconds. Burton's 28-footer and Stokes's block gave the Valkyries an 83-81 win and a 2-0 semifinal lead. Recap, key plays and stats.

/news/aces-valkyries-semis-game-3-recap/.title: Valkyries beat Aces 87-77 in OT to reach the WNBA Finals
/news/aces-valkyries-semis-game-3-recap/.description: The Valkyries beat the Aces 87-77 in overtime in Las Vegas to sweep the semifinals and reach the WNBA Finals. How the overtime went, with full stats.

/news/allisha-gray-game-3-status/.title: Allisha Gray out for Game 3 as Dream go for the sweep
/news/allisha-gray-game-3-status/.description: Allisha Gray is out for Game 3 in Brooklyn. The Dream will try to sweep the Liberty without their leading scorer. What her absence means for Atlanta.

/news/angel-reese-always-this-good-data/.title: Angel Reese's rebounding: double digits every season
/news/angel-reese-always-this-good-data/.description: Angel Reese has averaged 10+ rebounds in every full college and WNBA season. Our 124-game box score ledger shows the rebounding was always there.

/news/angel-reese-game-1-liberty/.title: Angel Reese follows DPOY award with four steals vs. Liberty
/news/angel-reese-game-1-liberty/.description: Three days after winning Defensive Player of the Year, Angel Reese had four steals from four Liberty players in a 92-82 Dream win in semifinal Game 1.

/news/angel-reese-game-2-stats-liberty-d.title: Angel Reese scores 23 as Dream take 2-0 lead over Liberty
/news/angel-reese-game-2-stats-liberty-d.description: Angel Reese's plus-11 was the best mark in Game 2. Free throws with 4.3 seconds left made it 101-98, and Atlanta leads the Liberty 2-0. Her full stat line.

/news/clark-no-call-aces-game-3/.title: Caitlin Clark's bloody-mouth no-call, a closer look
/news/clark-no-call-aces-game-3/.description: Caitlin Clark caught an elbow from Jewell Loyd with about three minutes left in Game 3. No foul was called and the Aces won 94-83. The rule and the replay.

/news/dream-mystics-game-1-howard-reese/.title: Dream rally from 11 down to beat Mystics in Game 1

/news/dream-sweep-liberty-game-3-semifin.title: Dream sweep the Liberty 85-83, head to the WNBA Finals

/news/dream-valkyries-finals-game-1-reca.title: Gabby Williams lifts Valkyries over Dream 68-64 in Game 1

/news/fever-aces-game-2-recap/.title: Clark hits back-to-back threes, Fever even series with Aces
/news/fever-aces-game-2-recap/.description: Caitlin Clark scored 27 points with 15 assists and Aliyah Boston had 22 as the Fever beat the Aces 99-89 to tie the first-round series 1-1. Full recap.

/news/fever-aces-game-3-recap/.description: A'ja Wilson scored 36 points with 10 rebounds as the Aces beat the Fever 94-83 to win the first-round series 2-1. Recap, key runs and the full box score.

/news/finals-game-2-preview-dream-valkyr.title: Finals Game 2 preview: Dream lost the turnover battle
/news/finals-game-2-preview-dream-valkyr.description: Atlanta won the turnover count in all five of its first playoff games, then lost it 12-8 in Finals Game 1. Game 2 is Monday at 5 p.m. PT.

/news/finals-game-3-preview-valkyries-dr.title: Finals Game 3 preview: Valkyries' missing free throws
/news/finals-game-3-preview-valkyries-dr.description: Golden State has scored 9 points and taken no free throws in the third quarter of both Finals games. Game 3 is tonight at 5 p.m. PT in Atlanta.
